title: Day 1: the job
summary: You are Rook, the crew's planner. Juno has a buyer for the Saints' ledger, and the Saints keep it in their chop shop on the docks.

locations.name: Main Room
locations.desc: Mismatched couches, a wall of monitors and rain on the window.

locations.name: Workshop
locations.desc: Mags's bench, half-built drones and the smell of solder.

locations.name: Back Alley
locations.desc: A wet alley behind the laundromat, the van parked under a dead sign.

facts: The buyer pays on delivery, tomorrow night.
opening:
Rain needles the window. On the monitors, a grainy drone shot of a docks warehouse loops: roller door, two Saints smoking under a light, a camera blinking red.

Juno taps the screen. "Ledger's in there. Vex keeps it in his office, behind a locked door, and the buyer wants it by tomorrow night."

From the workshop, Mags calls out without looking up. "I can get a drone onto the roof. Getting you through the door is your problem."
